integrity_notes: Fourier-normalization, subgroup and coordinate symmetries specified. General proof is algebraic; finite exact-rational and modular computations are corroborative, not an infinite proof. No claim of independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Only prime-power \(q\ge3\) and \(d\ge2q\); no equality classification for low dimensions or other support shells. Constant is of classical least-eigenvalue type; all-extremizer nonbinary resonance is the distinctive statement. Unindexed prior equivalent possible.
title: Sharp Turán mass and the nonradial resonance of nonbinary Hamming weight-two shells
